limitations: Finite-dimensional real SPD matrices with a fixed SPD block-diagonal split are assumed. The additive inverse is SPD exactly when ||D^{-1/2} L D^{-1/2}||_2<1; SPD of A alone is insufficient. The condition-number estimate is a worst-case weak-coupling bound, not a performance or floating-point guarantee. Full texts of several older splitting papers remain an originality-access risk.
provenance: Scientific sources and proof evidence are documented in RESULT.md and the dated audit files.
